summary: Frontend-only verification of the Profile screen refactor (extraction of ProfileHeader/PathCard/PsychicCard/ProgressCard/ActionsCard from /app/frontend/app/profile/[id].tsx + pickAvatar undefined-ref fix). Findings: ZERO regressions, ZERO red-screen errors, ZERO JS page errors. (1) SPA login + drawer navigation Users → My Profile → /profile/user_1bcd16097d5a works (page.goto would wipe the session_token in localStorage, so SPA navigation is required, as the request noted). (2) Self-profile renders fully: avatar fallback (initial E in gold ring) + Edit Profile button + name 'Etheria Dev' + Admin badge + Premium badge + 'Member since Apr 2026' badge + email hint (etheriasystems@gmail.com). All field blocks render: About Me ('Just the bio update'), Birthday (1990-05-21), Location (Asheville), Hobbies (reading), Favorite Things, Stuff I Dislike, Path I Walk (My Path, 'Am I in a coven?' = No, Deities = Hekate), Psychic Gifts (family talent Yes/'Grandmother saw spirits', self talent Yes/'Vivid dreams'), Why I Chose Etheria (Growth), Progress card with 6 stat tiles (1 / 2d / 2d / 4 / 2 / 73) + 'Show progress on my public profile' toggle = Visible, Favorite Guide (Selene), Psychic Interests chips (Tarot / Astrology / Mediumship). (5) ComposeModal verified end-to-end on Email mode: tap on Email tile slides up the sheet with correct title 'Email Donald', hint 'Their email stays private. They'll be able to reply directly to you.', Subject input (placeholder 'Subject'), body textarea (placeholder 'Write your message…'), 'Send' button. Both fields accept text. Close X button dismisses the modal cleanly (verified — modal no longer in DOM text after click). The Direct Mail tile is rendered and clickable from the same ActionsCard; the modal title would be 'Write to Donald' and hint 'Your letter will appear in their in-app inbox.' (verified via component source — same modal in different mode, code path is identical). (6) No console errors related to Profile/Field/Chip/ActionTile/ComposeModal/Switch/Avatar/pickAvatar. Only pre-existing global RN-web warnings (shadow*/textShadow* style props deprecated, pointerEvents prop deprecated, useNativeDriver missing, expo-router 'files' route warning) — none caused by this refactor.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Profile screen refactor is GREEN. Authoritative verification path: (a) login admin via /auth/login (math captcha = parse 'What is A OP B = ?' from page text, supports + and - ; submit then wait ~5s for redirect to /), (b) NEVER use page.goto to navigate after login — it wipes the localStorage session_token; use the drawer 'Users' → tap user name OR drawer 'My Profile' via in-page click() to stay inside the SPA, (c) the user-card click target is the TEXT NODE of the user's name (not the wrapping card div) — use page.mouse.click on the bounding-box center of get_by_text(name).first, (d) other-user routes are /profile/<user_id>; self route /my-profile redirects to /profile/<own_id>. The ComposeModal's Subject input has placeholder exactly 'Subject', body textarea has placeholder 'Write your message…' (em-dash, not three dots). Close X is an Ionicons close that lives inside the sheet's header — clicking the X dismisses correctly on web. Email tile label is exactly 'Email' so use get_by_text('Email', exact=True) — there's a separate 'Email' substring in the email-hint inside ProfileHeader so ensure scroll_into_view targets the ActionTile location (or use .last to disambiguate after scrolling).

Edit mode swaps the avatar Pressable, name TextInput, all Field components to editable, and surfaces both 'Change Photo' and 'Save Profile Changes' buttons. The non-self path correctly hides the email hint and renders the four-tile ActionsCard (Email / Direct Mail / IM / Add-to-Circle). ComposeModal slide-up sheet opens, accepts subject/body input, dismisses via X.
